根據馬雅預言，我們所生存的地球，是在所謂的第５太陽紀，到目前為止，地球已經過了四個太陽紀，而在每一紀結束時，都會上演一齣齣驚心動魄的毀滅劇情，以現今西曆對照這個終結日子，就在西元２０１２年１２月２２日前後 2009年，科學菁英團隊向美國總統證實，地球即將在2012年毀滅因此，世界各國首領緊急研議各種可能計畫，希望挽救大多數人類的生命，然而，並非所有人都能幸運獲救當男主角傑克森約翰庫薩克 飾演帶著他的兩個小孩前往黃石公園旅遊時，竟意外發現在乾涸的湖床底下有個秘密的科學研究機構，而裡頭藏著政府一直試圖隱瞞的末日震撼秘密

programme.title: 鋼鐵擂台
programme.desc: 2020年的拳擊賽改由人類操控的機器人上場代打，查理休傑克曼飾是個被時代淘汰的拳擊手，現在他只能在地下拳擊場操控二手的機器拳擊手比賽，並靠賭金維生但他也因此負債許多，所以為了翻轉地位，他必須要升級和積極地訓練拳擊手，所以他需要更多的資金此時從未謀面的兒子麥斯又突然出現，讓他頭疼不已還好麥斯意外發現被當成廢鐵的舊型機器人，可以承受強力的撞擊，但卻對拳擊打鬥一竅不通 於是，查理決定好好訓練它，並將他的拳擊技巧全教授給亞當，希望可以攜手拿下冠軍他們在地下拳擊場展開一場場的決鬥，並朝著冠軍邁進，就在查理進行對機器人的訓練同時，他與兒子的關係也越來越親密

programme.title: 死亡教室-母校
programme.desc: 故事敘述失去高中記憶的恩熙，回到高中母校擔任副校長一職，卻開始出現幻覺，還飽受幻聽的煎熬身為受害者卻被認為是問題學生的夏英，被引誘至學校的廢棄廁所，在那聽到了鬼的呼喚，甚至還遇見了與自己有同樣傷痛的恩熙兩人得知學校所發生的怪事都與廢棄廁所有關後，死亡的恐懼也向她們襲來隱藏於記憶中的衝擊真相即將揭曉

programme.title: 痞子英雄首部曲-全面開戰
programme.desc: 故事為電視版的前傳，設定於電視版的三年前，片尾結局將連接電視版第一集三年前的吳英雄，血氣方剛，在南區分局重案特勤組執勤，一辦案把整座城市鬧得天下大亂，被組長勒令外勤，卻固執追尋一宗離奇案件而城市的另一邊，最大黑幫三聯會的西岸堂口，年紀最大的三級幹部---徐達夫，挪用堂主的100萬現金偷偷去做鑽石買賣漆黑的貨櫃倉儲區，交易到手的達夫，突然遭受一支重裝隊伍亂槍掃射攻擊，混亂之中，循著線索來到現場的英雄就此碰上徐達夫...

programme.title: 劇場版 藍色監獄-EPISODE 凪
programme.desc: 劇場版的主角就是藍色監獄中最醒目的角色之二，一是才踢球半年卻靈活又聰明的絕對天才?誠士郎，另一位則是從小到大都不知道自己要追求什麼，直到遇見足球和?才有目標的超級富二代御影玲王而劇情描述討厭麻煩事且非常慵懶的?誠士郎，某天遇見了喜愛上足球且正在找尋同伴的御影玲王，兩人一同經歷了深刻的校園生活，以及後續進入藍色監獄所展開的各項訓練，也以不同的方式蛻變成長，全力開拓自己的足球天賦

programme.title: 激鬥-首部曲
programme.desc: 因反擊校園霸凌誤傷對方而被判入少年監獄服刑的車宇率，在獄中認識了綜合格鬥冠軍鄭道鉉，不想再被欺負的車宇率決定突破自我極限，向鄭道鉉學習格鬥技巧

programme.title: 九龍城寨之圍城
programme.desc: 落難青年陳洛軍（林? 飾）因得罪大老闆（洪金寶 飾）被追殺，為了避禍誤闖城寨，在城寨內結識了信一（劉俊謙 飾）十二少四仔等，成為換帖好兄弟眾兄弟們以龍捲風（古天樂 飾）馬首是瞻，奮力抵抗惡勢力大老闆（洪金寶 飾）的入侵，展開連番惡鬥，誓死保衛城寨這個安身之地的故事

programme.title: 喜歡你
programme.desc: 勝男是高級飯店餐廳的千年二廚，魚干女性格的超級俠女，生活迷糊加上白痴，但是卻是身手超級厲害的廚師，她和飯店總經理程子謙的秘密戀愛還沒著落，沒想到飯店財務危機而面臨倒閉成為財團收購目標，程子謙此時又提出分手，顧勝男面臨失去愛情與工作的雙重危機此時國際飯店財團總裁陸晉加入飯店的收購戰局，他是個毒舌又自大挑剔，秘密考察酒店大失所望，卻意外被勝男臨場救援的美食所打動，兩人因此展開唇槍舌戰的感情角力在喜歡你與討厭你兩股力量的拉扯下，他們會走向哪一端

programme.title: 航海王:1109
programme.desc: 偉大航路的黃金梅利號阿拉巴斯坦的王女．薇薇也在船上被稱為沙漠之國的阿拉巴斯坦王國，從以前就一直被不降雨的異常氣像所困擾，為人民著想的國王．寇布拉身邊，人人和平的生活著但是距今兩年前，雨變得只落在國王所居住的城市裡，同時間，世界政府禁止製造持有的人工降雨粉．跳舞粉也運往國王的身邊這事件成為國王與人民分裂的開端相信身為父親也是國王．寇布拉的薇薇，為了要把引起這異常氣像並陷害國王的邪惡組織的身分曝光而離開她的國家而現在為了阻止萬惡根源卻是國家英雄的克洛克達爾，薇薇和魯夫等夥伴一同前往阿拉巴斯坦為了奪回被奪走的重要東西而奔走！

programme.title: 賽德克．巴萊上太陽旗
programme.desc: 1930年，新來的日警因誤會和族人起衝突，自此馬赫坡社便活在恐遭日警報復的陰霾裡賽德克年輕人要求莫那魯道帶領他們反擊日本人，莫那清楚知道這是場必輸的戰役，更可能會滅族，但他決定挺身為民族尊嚴反擊，於是率領族內年輕人，準備奪回獵場

programme.title: 咒術屍戰
programme.desc: 敘述為了阻止甦醒的屍體再次犯下殺人案，主角們想盡辦法對抗活死人大軍的懸疑驚悚故事

programme.title: 古曼童
programme.desc: 講述住在湄公河三角洲村莊的聾啞女孩索依，在偶然之下認識了一位自稱是薩滿和治療師的陌生人修恩在修恩奇蹟般地治癒了一個當地人後，他很快便贏得村民的信任與讚賞索依也因而被修恩所深深吸引，兩人不久便陷入熱戀並結為連理然而當索依無意間發現修恩過往的黑暗祕密，以及他試圖尋求永生的恐怖計畫後，她的美夢很快地成為了一場噩夢

programme.title: 國產凌凌漆
programme.desc: 大陸國寶恐龍頭骨遭到神秘金鎗客所竊司令派出閒置十年不用的情報員凌凌漆周星馳到香港追查此案，同時也派手下李香琴袁詠儀殺凌漆香琴起初對漆充滿敵意，但在相處之後開始對司令的命令產生懷疑

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道長所在的村落中有一座殘舊的教堂，修女瑪利亞前往重開教堂，剛巧村裡無水可用，村長找一眉道長勘察地理來尋找問題的源頭，發現是村中突然多出大量蝙蝠，並棲身於此教堂裡

programme.title: 頭文字D
programme.desc: 一個快遞小子一個機械天才，和一個職業車手，三人將以驚心動魄的亡命飄移技術一較高下，誓言爭奪日本秋名山上的車神頭銜！ 五年來，十八歲的拓海每天駕著父親殘舊的Toyota AE86運送豆腐，卻無意中練得一手出神入化的飄移技術對汽車毫無興趣的他被父親慫恿參加山路賽，以平日送貨的舊車越級挑戰Nightkids車隊的EVOIV，比賽結果

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之英雄有夢
programme.desc: 故事上較著墨於黃飛鴻成為宗師前的惡戰與歷煉，頗有前傳意味1868年的清末，朝廷腐敗讓人民生活備受煎熬在廣州，黑虎幫和北海幫子兩大惡勢力橫行於黃埔港他們以暴力威脅統治在港口的窮苦人民，讓他們生活在水深火熱之中外界在看來，黃埔港是個繁榮並充滿機會地方，但深入其中，會發現這裡其實是人間煉獄黑虎幫的老闆雷公因一個新兵手下阿飛，以過人身手及膽識直取北海幫子首領的頭腦，而讓黑虎幫獨霸一方，不但靠鴉片賺進大筆銀兩，更進行著卑鄙的販賣人口勾當，雷公更視阿飛如己出其實，阿飛背後另有故事，心中更另有計畫他和肝膽相照的朋友們設了陷阱，救下窮苦的人們，更公開與雷公進行生死決鬥

programme.title: 危機航線
programme.desc: 國際安保專家高皓軍和失明的女兒小軍搭乘有空中巨無霸之稱的五星級超豪華客機A380的國際首航，途中遭遇暴徒劫機，無差別射殺的恐怖手段，讓豪華機艙瞬間變成密閉煉獄，800多名乘客危在旦夕，高皓軍挺身而出，在數千米的高空上與一眾暴徒周旋，劫匪頭目以全機800餘人的生命作為籌碼威脅，小軍的媽媽傅源也身陷危險之中，飛機能否平安降落，這場失控的危機該如何化解？

programme.title: 七龍珠超-超級英雄
programme.desc: 紅領巾軍被孫悟空滅掉的30年後，雷德統帥的兒子瑪仙達欲重組紅領巾軍來實現當時父親的野心，並矇騙了蓋洛博士的孫子海德博士來實現野心

programme.title: 賽德克．巴萊下彩虹橋
programme.desc: 賽德克，一個位於台灣山區信仰彩虹的民族，他們居住在山嵐繚繞的世外桃源，過著生態平衡的生活，族裡馬赫坡社出了一位英雄人物馬赫坡社頭目之子莫那魯道日治時代來臨，賽德克族裡男人搬木服勞役，而女人淪為幫傭，感到痛心的莫那魯道，內心深信祖靈訓示，唯有在自己的獵場，通過重重的試煉，在臉上紋上驕傲的印記，成為真正的賽德克人，在死後才能走上讓祖靈認同的彩虹橋

programme.desc: 金麥基（張學友飾）與孟超（許冠英飾）都在這所警署駐守，但他們一直不相信警署的傳說直到在孟蘭節當天他們親眼目睹疑犯蛇仔明（樓南光 飾）因遇到太陽在他們面前化作了灰土，原來蛇仔明在監獄內誤闖俱樂部並遇見了鬼魂，更被鬼魂威脅要把殭屍軍官三宅大佐（左頌昇飾）帶離俱樂部，蛇仔明更被大佐咬而變成了殭屍這時，他們才相信警署內的確有陰魂的事實

programme.title: 師兄撞鬼
programme.desc: 幹探張標在偵查製毒機關時遭毒梟槍殺，死後在天堂法庭受審，法官准其回到凡間緝兇，更指點他尋找有梅花胎記之救星協助報仇張標尋得其救星乃乖巧滑頭學警阿星，逐暗中保護張標現身向阿星表明來意，令阿星又驚又喜，人鬼卒達成協議，張標負責幫阿星泡妞立功，阿星則助他尋兇報仇

programme.title: 捉妖記2
programme.desc: 天蔭井柏然 飾帶著小嵐白百何 飾踏上尋父之路，而重回永寧村的胡巴再度被妖王追殺，危難中被賭徒屠四谷梁朝偉 飾和他的妖怪老友笨笨相救屠四谷欠下巨額賭債，被逼肉償下嫁惡女債主，當他無意中得知小妖王胡巴的重金懸賞令後，決定高價出售胡巴與此同時，念子心切的天蔭和小嵐通過天師堂堂主雲大哥楊祐寧 飾的幫助，與屠四谷交易贖回胡巴胡巴以為一家重逢，豈料，一場更大的驚天陰謀尾隨而至，伺機而動......

programme.title: 我裡面的那傢伙
programme.desc: 黑道老大板壽被意外從高樓墜落的弱雞高中生東賢撞上，兩人因此靈魂互換，板壽也展開奔波於校園和穩固地盤的笑鬧高中人生同時還得面對自己原本身體仍陷入昏迷敵人趁機奪取地盤的陰謀就在接連出現的問題讓板壽頭痛不已時，變成黑道大哥的東賢終於醒來

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-沈默的15分鐘
programme.desc: 東京市長朝倉突然收到一封神秘的恐嚇信，隔日其一手策劃完成的新地下鐵隧道隨即遭人炸毀！柯南調查後發現，市長於國土交通部部長任內曾興建過水庫，極有可能因此遭人懷恨

programme.title: 人在囧途
programme.desc: 一年一度的農曆春節將至，到處擠滿了想回家的人潮，任何的交通工具更是一票難求製造玩具集團老闆李成功（徐崢飾）在二奶的逼迫下，計畫回家鄉長沙過年的同時，也打算要跟大老婆攤牌離婚另一邊身為擠奶工的牛耿王寶強飾，因為牛奶牧場倒閉讓他和其他工友陷入經濟危機，於是帶著大家期望的牛耿起身要到長沙討債 因緣際會下，兩人結伴前往長沙並且無所不用其極地轉換各種交通工具，不論是航空鐵路海運甚至是農用的托拉機，路途中遇見各式各樣的人和千奇百怪的事，囧事不斷使得歸鄉的路途漫長地看不到終點，然而，天真樂觀的牛耿和冷漠理性的李成功在路途中又會摩擦出怎樣的火花，對他們兩的人生又會起怎樣的變化呢？

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之降龍十八掌
programme.desc: 大漠少年郭靖隨師父江南六怪下江南歷練，偶遇黃藥師之女黃蓉，二人捲入爭奪九陰真經的江湖陰謀郭靖屢遭險境，幸得洪七公老頑童等武林高手指點，武功步步精進西毒歐陽鋒登桃花島提親，為奪真經掀起江湖血雨腥風郭靖肩負重任，踏上決戰華山之巔的征途

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: 茅山師父九叔受委託為任老爺起棺遷葬，惟任老爺之屍體屍變，變成殭屍，並四處為害此時，九叔的兩名徒弟文才及秋生亦分別因女友婷婷而被殭屍所傷，以及受女鬼小玉所迷惑九叔如何同時面對徒弟們生死存亡，以及殭屍為害的問題呢？

programme.title: 角頭2-王者再起
programme.desc: 故事描述仁哥（王識賢 飾演）面對曾經的好兄弟，如今卻走味變成最換帖的敵人的劉健（鄒兆龍 飾演）重現江湖，不斷挑起紛爭與衝突，破壞仁哥的忍耐與努力維持的和平看著劉健的事業版圖逐漸擴大，身邊的兄弟為了情義有所犧牲，仁哥終究按耐不住釋放出心中的猛獸，與亦敵亦友的劉健正式開戰，為江湖掀起腥風血雨的廝殺

programme.title: 角頭-浪流連
programme.desc: 故事描述阿慶（鄭人碩 飾演）在北館角頭大哥 仁哥的女兒滿月宴上，偶遇攝影師小淇（謝欣穎 飾演）進而衍生出一段相愛卻不能相守的愛情故事 身為角頭的阿慶遇到了小淇，原本水火不容的兩人，再一次次的爭吵中發現其實自己最在乎對方阿慶與小淇相愛相知相惜互相扶持，阿慶為小淇解決困難小淇在阿慶事業遇到瓶頸時給予鼓勵但就在此時湳沆的世界在背地裡陷害北館販毒，不僅讓北館深陷危機，仁哥與五虎們相繼誤解阿慶，小淇也因為阿慶受重傷阿慶分身乏術，痛定思痛決定奮力一搏

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大，某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻不派齊君元追查，他決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗中調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元更發現自己身陷一個局，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人是何許人也？

programme.title: 大稻埕
programme.desc: 大學生陳佑熙，是個有點小憂鬱，沒有太大人生目標的大學生，失戀之後，萬念俱灰誰知在有點古怪的歷史系朱正德教授的引導下，佑熙竟然陰錯陽差地掉入時光隧道，回到大稻埕1920年代日治時期台灣最繁華的第一鬧區，還遇到朱教授

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: 茅山師父九叔受委託為任老爺起棺遷葬，惟任老爺之屍體屍變，變成殭屍，並四處為害此時，九叔的兩名徒弟文才及秋生亦分別因女友婷婷而被殭屍所傷，以及受女鬼小玉所迷惑九叔如何同時面對徒弟們生死存亡，以及殭屍為害的問題呢？

programme.title: 唐人街探案
programme.desc: 本該是一趟完美泰國行，卻變成殺人行不行少年秦風警校落榜，包袱款款，要去海外散散心，並找了號稱唐人街第一神探的表舅唐仁來做陪一晚上花天酒地，才睜開眼睛，卻是哀天叫地，一樁離奇謀殺，唐仁被指為兇手，鐵血警探拘捕在即，更有兩光匪幫追殺在後，連唐人街教父都來湊一腳，他們要如何在時限內找出真相？多路人馬連環套，荒誕骨牌效應一連串，最不正經，地動天驚，恐怖殺人，笑能死人

programme.title: 劇場版派遣女醫 X Final
programme.desc: 當今的日本，白色巨塔已然崩壞，本該是拯救生命的醫療體制，也被迫迎來弱肉強食的時代在陷入危機的日本醫療現場，一群獨來獨往的自由醫生出現了，他們就像獨行俠般，不受體制牽絆，一如這位美麗性感的天才外科醫生大門未知子（米倉涼子飾演），她討厭成群結黨討厭權威討厭束縛，專業醫師執照與扎實養成的醫術，是她的唯一武器 這回，大門為了拯救某國總統的生命而離開日本...

programme.title: 天降神機
programme.desc: 黃星徹，18歲，幼時跟隨祖父母住在沿海一帶，直到國中才搬回與父母同住，期待著一個陌生又溫馨的家庭關係，然而好景不常，家中因父親賭債開始四處躲藏，母親也在償還債務後毅然決然離去，阿徹看在眼裡對母親沒有怨恨反倒徒留不捨，然而對以酒洗面的父親極度埋怨，兩人相處充滿在仇恨與怨懟之中，因父親在工地打臨時工與警察二叔的投靠，阿徹也在不停轉換學校與環境的過程，養成自力更生的能力，但一切轉換的不適與父親的關係等無處發洩，藉由打架與不良學生的標籤得以找到暫時的存在感

programme.title: 哪吒之魔童降世
programme.desc: 元始天尊將混元珠提煉成靈珠和魔丸，本應是靈珠轉世的哪吒因為太乙真人的失誤被魔丸托生，生來便註定是混世魔王在太乙真人的幫助下，希望哪吒可以學習本領，為民除害期間，哪吒認識了龍王之子敖丙，成為了彼此各自唯一的朋友然而面對人們的誤解和天雷的降臨，哪吒是否命中注定會立地成魔？他將何去何從？

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，更有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，而徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，大斗其法，兩個冤家徒弟也搞笑連連，笑料頻出某天，一支奇異的喪葬隊伍路過此地，某邊疆皇族中屍毒死去，幻化成殭屍，千鶴道長及王子護送棺木上京途中遭遇暴雨，棺木被雷劈開，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 錦衣衛-修羅戰場
programme.desc: 明朝天啟七年，北鎮撫司錦衣衛沈煉（張震 飾）在一次掃除亂黨任務中，為救畫師北齋（楊冪 飾），失手將同僚淩雲鎧（武強 飾）殺害此後便將自己陷入無盡深淵，一方面要應付來自陸文昭（張譯 飾）裴綸（雷佳音 飾）輪番質疑與調查，另一方面還被神秘女子要脅要放火燒了錦衣衛經歷司，並助她暗中挖掘醜陋的真相

programme.title: 百大醫言堂
programme.desc: 台灣許多名醫，或許我們聽過他的大名，但始終掛不到號，沒關係！百大醫言堂幫您邀請到現場，親自為您解答各種疑難雜症！ 百大醫言堂是由慈月基金會及神腦科技文教基金會聯合出品，目的是傳遞最正確最實用最先進的疾病相關資訊每集我們會邀請一位不同領域的權威醫師，親自到現場分享，為國人的健康把關，這不僅是一個節目，更是您了解健康掌握未來的橋樑

programme.title: 風味轉身
programme.desc: 有故事的台灣物產有故事的台灣農漁人，以及熱愛土地的知名料理人，共同挑戰一場風味轉身的旅程節目走訪台灣山林與海洋，從產地到餐桌，帶領觀眾探索台灣物產的前世今生，深入農漁現場，貼近生產者的日常與堅持，聆聽土地孕育出的動人故事每一集將同時邀請知名主廚以獨特的料理視角重新詮釋在地食材，將產地面臨的挑戰化為創新的風味，讓每一道料理不只是美味，更承載土地人情與永續的價值，完成一場從產地到餐桌的精彩風味轉身

programme.title: 戇夫成龍:3
programme.desc: 事情緣起於傻仔丁常旺，旺本是豪門富商包慶豐九代單傳的獨子，旺母本是包老爺的妾侍，因原配夫人妒忌，誣捏旺母與家樸有染，包老爺盛怒之下，視有了身孕的旺母是懷有孽種，把旺母逐出家門，旺母流落異鄉並誕下旺，兩母子過了二十幾年相依為命的艱苦生活而包老爺二十多年來仍無子嗣，直至原配夫人患病去迦後，包老爺有感膝下無子承繼家產，遂派親侄包大業往尋旺兩母子，知不尋獲，包老爺寧願臨老續娶求子，也不會把家業傳給親侄大業一直欲承繼包老爺家產，如今希望幻滅，遂起歪心，在尋到旺兩母子時，暗中加害之，旺母死，旺被打傷後腦滾下山崖業以為旺已死，即找來一個身份卑賤的孤兒，頂包假冒包老爺之子，改名為包繼宗大業並編造故事，令繼宗亦以為自己就是流落在外的包家少爺

programme.desc: 反映現今社會，無論富或貧皆有誤入歧途的人，但祇要決心洗心革面，改邪歸正，社會必定會接納他們反之，那些死不悔改，繼續為非作歹的人，最終必會受到法律制裁，並且落得慘淡收場明天（萬梓良）原是黑道英雄，後因一次買賣中，未婚妻（楊寶玲）意外身亡，大受打擊之餘，決洗心革面，經營聯誼會為生明天與母親（李香琴），舅父何英彪（吳孟達）及表弟向鑫淼（周星馳）同住，彪一直懷疑天是當年導致他被革離警隊的人，故對他諸多單打

programme.title: 戇夫成龍:5
programme.desc: 事情緣起於傻仔丁常旺，旺本是豪門富商包慶豐九代單傳的獨子，旺母本是包老爺的妾侍，因原配夫人妒忌，誣捏旺母與家樸有染，包老爺盛怒之下，視有了身孕的旺母是懷有孽種，把旺母逐出家門，旺母流落異鄉並誕下旺，兩母子過了二十幾年相依為命的艱苦生活而包老爺二十多年來仍無子嗣，直至原配夫人患病去迦後，包老爺有感膝下無子承繼家產，遂派親侄包大業往尋旺兩母子，知不尋獲，包老爺寧願臨老續娶求子，也不會把家業傳給親侄大業一直欲承繼包老爺家產，如今希望幻滅，遂起歪心，在尋到旺兩母子時，暗中加害之，旺母死，旺被打傷後腦滾下山崖業以為旺已死，即找來一個身份卑賤的孤兒，頂包假冒包老爺之子，改名為包繼宗大業並編造故事，令繼宗亦以為自己就是流落在外的包家少爺

programme.title: 他來自江湖:30
programme.desc: 反映現今社會，無論富或貧皆有誤入歧途的人，但祇要決心洗心革面，改邪歸正，社會必定會接納他們反之，那些死不悔改，繼續為非作歹的人，最終必會受到法律制裁，並且落得慘淡收場明天（萬梓良）原是黑道英雄，後因一次買賣中，未婚妻（楊寶玲）意外身亡，大受打擊之餘，決洗心革面，經營聯誼會為生明天與母親（李香琴），舅父何英彪（吳孟達）及表弟向鑫淼（周星馳）同住，彪一直懷疑天是當年導致他被革離警隊的人，故對他諸多單打

programme.title: News金探號
programme.desc: 抓住財經趨勢，打理健康財富，探索知識旅程，創造時尚風格，都在News金探號，幫你一網打盡!!!吃喝玩樂樣樣都是商機，不是經濟不景氣，就怕不懂動腦筋，如何異軍突起，贏得消費者的關愛眼光，News金探號 要帶觀眾探索另類商機身價破表，搞怪寵物商機，這些特殊寵物個個身價不斐，有的甚至比一棟豪宅還貴，搞怪寵物商機讓人瞠目結舌台灣揚名國際的觀光特色夜市，夜市商機創造台灣的經濟奇蹟舉凡全省熱鬧的旅遊勝地，不乏人潮擁擠的夜市美食，在夜市擺攤賺豪宅，賣特色料理，在地商品，夜市商機錢淹腳目虛擬通路網路購物每年20成長，網路商城團購網琳瑯滿目，網路最夯的商品是甚麼，科技新貴轉業網購，百萬年薪不是夢，網友鄉民新社群影響力，為網購市場締造另類行銷模式，商機無限可能，就看商品夠不夠炫

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: 城中之城
programme.desc: 聚焦2018年前後金融改革與發展，以兩代金融人的迷茫與奮鬥守正與搏殺的人生抉擇為切入口，全景式地展開金融城內銀行證券信託投行地產商等各色人等的命運沉浮，折射出金融改革與發展大時代的奔湧浪潮！

programme.title: Life Hotel

programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns featuring three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist, and a chef. (这部恐怖杂志系列重返, 讲述了三个可怕的犯罪故事, 一个前模特, 一个爱猫,)

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-storey Demon Buil (探偵迪和九層樓魔鬼建築)
programme.desc: Detective Dee investigates a series of strange incidents at Tangs building, finding the master suspicious when even his eldest daughter secretly tells Dee of his odd behavior. (探偵迪在唐斯大樓調查了一系列奇怪事件, 發現主人懷疑, 即使是他的長女秘密地告訴迪他的奇怪行為.)

programme.title: Always Have Always Will ((原来时光都记得))
programme.desc: A struggling young man encounters a spirited girl and embarks on an uncertain journey. Together they share joys and sorrows, supporting each other through highs and lows, bringing light to darkness.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast ((金玉满堂))
programme.desc: Sun moves to Canada to become a chef but struggles with his skills but must represent the restaurant in a contest. Seeking help from a legendary chef, Sun fights to achieve his dream. (孙搬到加拿大成为厨师,但他不太擅长,但必须代表餐厅参加比赛.)

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die ((提防老千))
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy when he is sent to prison for embezzlement. After their release, they team up with Teddys lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge? (尼克遇到了泰迪,他被送入监狱因为钱,他们被释放后,他们和泰迪的爱人洛拉合作,)

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night ((风林火山))
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the familys criminal empire. (在雪上加的超现实香港,一场爆炸杀死了一个秘密的毒品君.)

programme.title: The Fierce Wife ((犀利人妻))
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love? (因离婚后,她必须做一个关键决定.)

programme.title: Dust to Dust ((塵歸塵))
programme.desc: A blurred figure in a news clip prompts retired cop Wang Shou Yue to reinvestigate a cold case where the mastermind gets tipped off and escapes. A battle between good and evil has just begun! (报道片中的模糊人物促使退休警察王周尤重新调查一个冷酷的案件,)

programme.title: Welcome To My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a breakup and an accident, Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks. It is only when he meets Jia Nan that her presence chases them away and sparks an absurd yet sweet romance. (在分手和意外之后,小周被一群摇摇欲坠的橡皮鸭缠住了。 只有当他见到贾南时,她才将她们赶走,并点燃荒谬而甜蜜的爱情。)

programme.title: American Girl ((中文))
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mothers sickness her younger sisters misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: The Shadows Edge ((The 影子 Edge))
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves steals billions, outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system. The Macau police enlist retired expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild the elite squad and hunt down the mastermind. (澳门警方招募退休专家王德中重建精英队并追捕幕后黑手。)

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo ((山忌：黄衣小飞侠))
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends enter a remote mountain, unaware its a forbidden area. Soon, a boy in a yellow raincoat appears, and eerie events begin to unveil the mountains ancient curse.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2 Ep01 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S2 Ep01))
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2 Ep03 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S2 Ep03))
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2 Ep04 ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门 S2 Ep04))
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. (让斯图和利夫乱,他们试图取一个大蓝舌. 让杰斯和丹一起跑时间,他们试图拯救一个怀孕的蛇,)

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas S2 Ep05 ((阿尔法战士 S2 Ep05))
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, our planet is a battleground as animals go head to head, in Battle of the Alphas. (从土地战争到食物战斗,到交配混乱,自然是竞争和成为最好的追求.)

programme.title: Ocean Parks S1 Ep01 (海洋公园S1 Ep01)

programme.desc: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band. (追踪四个不同的物种的四个家庭 - - 富有资源的海队,战斗的沙漠队,纪律的河流队,和平的山区队.)

programme.title: Into the Wild India S1 Ep01 ((深入印度 S1 Ep01))
programme.desc: Hoolock Gibbons are true specialists of the Indian Jungle. Living in close knit family groups, youngsters must spend up to 9 years learning all the skills required to survive alone. (胡洛克·吉本斯是印度林的真正专家. 住在密切联系的家庭群体中,)

programme.title: Into the Wild India S1 Ep02 ((深入印度 S1 Ep02))
programme.desc: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of Indias most iconic creatures to thrive. (印度东北的草地是地球上最肥沃的息地之一.这里繁荣着数百种高草,使得印度最具代表性的生物之一繁荣.)

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep03 (动物帝国 S1 Ep03)

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep04 (动物帝国 S1 Ep04)

programme.title: Animal Empires S1 Ep05 (动物帝国 S1 Ep05)

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobras blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his fathers old rival.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Lius disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, hed still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tais best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he ill

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial worlds greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gangs hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the governments secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperors ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.desc: This large-scale tourism programme is designed to present the rich tourism resources in China and around the world.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk an

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named Wind and Cloud could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his fathers death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late fathers friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yips boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victims sister takes revenge by spiking the rapists drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.desc: 何广沛联同女团MYNT成员宋宛颖倪嘉雯倪乐琳庄子璇乔美莎卢映彤，深入澳门大街小巷，开展一趟集结创新料理世纪老店独特工艺与趣味娱乐的满Fun探索之旅各人会透过参与制作难题考验打卡趣味历史考究等比拼，引领观众解锁隐藏于澳门各个角落的特色店铺怀旧老字号及网红地标另会介绍澳门特色观光休游巴士路线与沿途景点，以及新登场的澳门历史探游记攻略，让大家感受多个古迹的文化魅力.

programme.title: 一周星星 Star Weekly
programme.desc: 访谈节目一周星星，每集邀请星级艺人界别名人，与区永权许文轩王镇泉等娱乐主播，分享新近工作企划，谈论电影电视演唱会相关的特别话题，尤其是网民与圈中朋友关心热议的人和事！周边讯息如此多，节目特设Fact Check核实环节，由嘉宾亲自回应各式各样的传闻，让当事人说清楚个中真相！.

programme.title: 美食新闻周报 Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食！黄嘉雯倪嘉雯伍倩彤等美食主播主持，紧贴最新美食潮流，从不同平台网罗超人气餐厅消息，主持亲自试食，带来真实食评；发掘各区扫街名物，又相约居港多年外籍人士，到访经他们认证的家乡风味食肆；名厨食评家亦会带路搵食，带来专业推介节目精选美食新闻报道介绍的多间人气餐厅，力推当中招牌美食，并会速递美食优惠，让观众实时掌握最滋味抵食的饮食情报.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 碧血鹽梟 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 那些我愛過的人 Life After Death
programme.desc: 七年前一宗嚴重車禍，破壞了兩個家庭，改變了姜煜誠林文龍飾方樂汶黃翠如飾的人生七年後一次交通意外，讓煜誠重遇樂汶，生活仍然有悲有喜樂汶與妹妹方書文連詩雅飾因身邊人逐一離開而鬧僵，沒想到行為怪異的醫生古希晨馬貫東飾，卻能直搗問題根源樂汶忙於照顧女兒朱幸而及繼子朱嘉炳顧定軒飾，煜誠則一直未能了解獨女姜子優蘇皓兒飾的需要子優和嘉炳因緣走近，共同朋友莫宇謙李任燊飾竟為此段關係衍生更多問題，也令當年車禍真相漸漸浮現，眾人亦要再次面臨改變.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.desc: Kisah ahli perniagaan London yang rendah hati Quan, yang masa lalunya yang telah lama terkubur meletus dalam dendam yang didorong oleh dendam apabila satu-satunya orang yang ditinggalkan untuk dicintainya - anak perempuan remajanya - diambil daripadanya dalam tindakan keganasan bermotif politik yang tidak masuk akal . Dalam pencarian tanpa henti untuk identiti pengganas, Quan terpaksa terlibat dalam konflik kucing-dan-tikus dengan seorang pegawai kerajaan Ireland, yang masa lalunya mungkin mengandungi petunjuk tentang identiti pembunuh yang sukar difahami.

programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan roh duit syiling di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.title: Jangan Pandang Belakang
programme.desc: Darma trauma dengan bunuh diri tunangnya, Rose, yang telah dihantui oleh makhluk halus jahat. Roh tersebut secara tidak sengaja dibebaskan oleh pasangan itu selepas mereka menemui sebuah balang kecil yang terdampar di pantai. Selepas kematian Rose, Darma membawa balang itu bersamanya, tanpa disedari telah membawa roh tersebut ke dalam hidupnya. Terkejut dengan kejadian bunuh diri itu, Darma bekerjasama dengan adik kembar Rose, Seri, untuk menyiasat. Semasa mereka menyiasat, pelbagai kejadian aneh berlaku, menyebabkan keadaan mental Darma semakin merosot dan memberi kesan kepada kerjayanya. Dia pulang ke kampung untuk berehat, tanpa disedari semakin hampir dengan kebenaran. Akhirnya, terungkap bahawa nenek Darma secara tidak sengaja telah mengundang roh yang dikenali sebagai Saka ke dalam rumah mereka, satu roh yang menghantui keturunan pemiliknya selepas kematian.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Sate

Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.desc: Seorang remaja lelaki bernama Gadis bertemu Vino, seorang gadis misteri yang hanya boleh muncul selepas matahari terbenam. Persahabatan mereka perlahan-lahan berubah menjadi hubungan istimewa sambil menyimpan rahsia besar.

programme.desc: Devan Farhan Rasyid, seorang mahasiswa yang sedang menyiapkan tesis tentang komuniti pasar, bertemu Alya Adzwa Aurell, seorang pemandu lori wanita ketika menjalankan kajiannya. Selepas pertemuan mereka berakhir dengan pertelingkahan, Devan terpaksa menyamar untuk mendekati Alya semula tanpa diketahui identiti sebenarnya.

programme.title: Mega Series Suara Hati Istri: Anjani
programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: THE EXCLUSIVE: BEAT THE DEVILS TATTOO
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: SORI: VOICE FROM THE HEART ((机器人SORI))
programme.desc: A father searching for his missing daughter finds a satellite that remembers sounds from across the world. Using his daughters voice as a beacon, the satellite helps him track her down. (一位父亲在寻找失踪的女儿时发现了一个卫星,它能记住来自世界各地的声音.)

programme.title: THE WHISTLEBLOWER ((告密者))
programme.desc: A disgraced Korean researcher claims to have successfully cloned human embryo stem cells. However, the results were revealed to be fabricated along with other unethical practices later. (韩国一名尬的研究人员声称成功克隆了人类胚胎干细胞.)

programme.title: THE FIRST RIDE (第一旅程)
programme.desc: Four lifelong friends reunite for a long-postponed trip to Thailand. An uninvited guest suddenly joins in and their dream trip begins spiraling into total, glorious chaos. (四个终身朋友重新团聚,前往泰国的行程被长期推迟。 一位未受邀请的客人突然加入其中,他们的梦想之旅开始演变成彻底的、光荣的混乱。)

programme.title: ABROAD ((异乡历劫))
programme.desc: Taemin and Minji travel to see the aurora borealis. Later, Minji mysteriously disappears. Taemin wants to find Minji himself. The deeper he explores. the more surreal his world becomes... (泰明和明吉去看北极光,后来明吉神秘地消失了.泰明想找到明吉自己.他探索得越深,他的世界越是超现实的.)

programme.title: JOSEON CHEFS ((需云杂方))
programme.desc: A nobleman who has passed the national civil service exam meets the self-proclaimed best chef in Joseon, falls into the world of gourmet food, and sets out to find the life he truly wants. (一位通过国家公务员考试的贵族遇到了自称为子最好的厨师,)

programme.title: PILOT ((宋旻浩的Pilot))
programme.desc: Han Jung-woo is a popular star pilot. He is unable to work in any company due to a momentary mistake. He later gets a job with his sisters identity but his new job is soon threatened. (汉正宇是一位受欢迎的星级飞行员,由于短暂的错误,他无法在任何公司工作。 后来他得到了一份具有姐妹身份的工作,但他的新工作很快受到威胁。)

programme.title: THE SNITCH ((毒枭回忆录))
programme.desc: Kang-soo was falsely accused and imprisoned. A prosecutor offered him a deal to be a snitch in exchange for a reduced sentence and Kang-soo starts to shake up the drug investigation... (检察官向他提供一个交易,以换取减刑,)

programme.title: THE ROUNDUP: NO WAY OUT (没有办法出门)
programme.desc: There is a drug case links to an organized crime organization in Japan. Despite the expanding scale of the case, the beast cop and his team strive their best to arrest the criminal... (尽管案件规模不断扩大,野兽警察和他的团队尽最大努力逮捕犯罪者...)

programme.title: EXHUMA ((破墓))
programme.desc: Exhuma follows two shamans, a feng shui expert and an undertaker as they seek to help a Korean-American family tormented by an ancestral curse. (埃克舒马跟着两个巫师,一个士师和一个葬礼员,)

programme.title: SPLIT ((分道扬镳))
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: DARK NUNS ((黑修女们))
programme.desc: An evil spirit possesses a boy and his life is at risk. 2 nuns embark on a dangerous ritual and are determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. (邪恶的灵魂拥有一个男孩,他的生命处于危险之中。 2名修女走上危险的仪式,决心不惜一切代价拯救男孩,不管风险或后果如何。)

programme.title: MISS FORTUNE ((爱上我的衰神))
programme.desc: Swindler Ji-Hye is looking to make her last big score. Together with her daughter, they infiltrate the house of a cultural property broker with a net worth of 60 billion won. (骗子吉海想出最后一个大分,她和女儿一起,)

programme.title: SPIRITWALKER (精神步行者)
programme.desc: A man loses memory and wakes up in a new body every 12 hours. In search of his identity, he met a woman who claims to know him. (一个男人每12小时就失去了记忆,每隔12小时就醒来,一个女人说他认识他,)

programme.title: THE SWINDLERS ((玩家))
programme.desc: Though each has their own motives, unlikely individuals from different sides of the law allies together to achieve a common goal - trapping the worlds most legendary con man. (尽管每个人都有自己的动机, 不可能来自不同法律部门的个人, 结合在一起, 实现一个共同的目标 - - 陷入世界上最传奇的骗子.)

programme.title: PICNIC ((梦旅人))
programme.desc: Eun-sim is an elderly living alone in Seoul. She heads to her hometown after decades away. Her long-lost memories come to life one by one. This could be the start of one last picnic...

programme.title: A MAN OF REASON ((保护者))
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a man learns that he has a daughter, thus wishes to leave the gangs and live an ordinary life. Yet the new leader of the gangs feels being betrayed... (一个男人从监狱中获释后,他发现他有一个女儿,因此希望离开帮派,)

programme.title: THE WAY HOME ((归家之旅))
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang-woo, a spoiled city boy, is sent to live with his mute grandmother in a remote rural village. Cut off from modern comforts, he slowly adapts as a quiet bond begins to form. (7岁的尚宇(Sang-woo),一个被宠坏的城市男孩,被派去与他的哑巴祖母一起住在一个偏远的乡村村庄里。 与现代的舒适隔绝,他逐渐适应了平静的纽带开始形成。)

programme.title: ONE WIN (一个胜利)
programme.desc: Woo-jin is the newly appointed manager of a girls volleyball team which is going to disband. The new owner sold all ace players for money and asked the team to win at least once. (伍是刚刚任命的女排队的经理,该队将会解散. 新的主人卖掉了所有的球员,并要求球队至少赢得一次胜利.)

programme.title: SPLIT ((分道扬镳))
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: THE KING ((七王国的骑士))
programme.desc: Believing power is paramount, Tae-soo aspires to become a prosecutor. As he achieves his goal and rises to power, he also sees the cruelty of a life at the top hierarchy in 90s Korea.

programme.title: NO OTHER CHOICE (没有其他选择)
programme.desc: After being laid off, Man-su spends a year attending interviews and working at retail store. He cannot get back to the industry so he comes to a decision that will bring him a job... (Man-su被解雇后,在零售商店接受面试和工作一年。他无法回到该行业,因此他决定给他带来一份工作。)

programme.title: The Judge Returns
programme.desc: Judge Lee Han-young, who regains consciousness after an unjust death, returns to the past to punish the wrongdoers and change his fate.

programme.title: Abra-ca Empty: The Weight We Share (Abra-ca 空: 我们共享的重量)
programme.desc: Four travelers embark on a two-week journey to four destinations with just one shared suitcase, turning every packing choice into a challenge, compromise and adventure. (四名旅行者前往四个目的地,为期两周,只有一个共用的手提箱,将每一个包装选择变成挑战、妥协和冒险。)

programme.title: You Can Cook With Sam Kim ((金喜泰))

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies (周林 他的三兄弟会)
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets. (Wong Cho-lam在一丝不苟地前往东川和尚图之后,继续其系列真实的系列风格和另一个旅行计划。然而,这一次,由朋友加入地狱,主题将是沿Cho-lams生活的里程碑进行一系列深入的重新审视,揭示日常生活的乐趣和温暖。拍摄地点横跨福州、广西和温哥华三地,这些地方在Cho-lam的生活的不同阶段对Cho-lam有着重要的意义。Cho-lam与三组旅行朋友在街道和巷子里走过,探索从家乡联系和文化觉醒到最重要的浪漫命运,通过旅行片讲述他的独特故事。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong ((有港回信))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. (报道关于香港,跨海和国际事务的重要新闻.)

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show Mean Talk hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most Mean way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as Mean Talk, guests must lower their standards and be Mean to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a Mean Confession Voucher, promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

(柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT ((未来警察))

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers. (Elena Kong再次领导团队,与张春龙、楚曼汉、吴宜宽和郑俊旺联合组建了Triing It Out团队,在第一季打完后以赞美和网友的热情赞美回来。 这次对台湾的新的深入探索将看到团队继续其放松、真实和自下而上的方式,引导观众深入岛屿心脏。 团队前往高盛、太南和台北,通过通过对极化的在线评论以及隐藏的宝石和鲜为人知的经验揭开有争议的商店,继续展示其精神。 团队致力于展示最真实的现场反馈,旨在创建实用的台湾旅游指南,避免观众陷入陷阱。)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2 ((女神配对计划 Sr.2))
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates. (与女神交配的真人秀《与女神的约会》又回到了一起,第二季的爱情战场也都升级了!金媒人鲍勃·拉姆正在从世界各地招募男人来配对女神何培霞、郭培勉、陈若熙、于克采诚和元甲曼。勇敢的追求者面临着挑战,比如,用他们自己的独特策略来赢得女神。一对一的亲密游戏点燃了燃心的兴奋情绪,一个隐藏的女神加入了这场争斗,进一步加大了等待的火花,勇敢的求婚者们努力到达终点并捕捉女神的心!此外,上个季节的五个女神,以及名人宾,将轮流成为Peanut小组,提供女神约会的现场报道。)

programme.title: Super Fun in Macau
programme.desc: Matthew Ho, along with members of the girl group MYNTSabrina Mendes,Carmen Ngai ,Ellyn Ngai ,Hilary Chong,Chelsea Mason and Skylar Lodeeply explored the streets and alleys of Macau, embarking on a fun-filled journey that combines innovative cuisine, century-old shops, unique crafts, and entertaining activities. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macaus unique leisure bus routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched Macau History Exploration Guide, allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.

programme.title: Running Out Of Time ((暗战))
programme.desc: Hua, who only has fourteen days to live, decides to play a seventy-two-hour game with the police, robbing a jewelry company and taking hostages. Officer Sheng suspects Huas actions are aimed at him, and after several twists and turns, Hua is finally apprehended. In reality, Hua and Sheng secretly share a mutual respect knowing Huas days are numbered, Sheng devises a plan to release him

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small (香港:永远不要太小)
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces. (在时间的流逝和流逝中,描述城市缩影的当地商店越来越少见。然而,它们是城市结构的重要部分,也是香港精神不可替代的体现。铭记这一点,下到土宿主Louis Yuen带领观光员逐商店探索、参观时间充裕的现代商店,横跨日常生活的四个关键领域:服装、食品、住房和交通。他揭示了经营历史的商店、维护历史的困难以及几代人的故事,利用这些有形商店保存无形的记忆并展示小空间的持久美景。)

programme.title: Thai Rogered Sr.11 ((冲游泰国 第四辑 Sr.11))
programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, Bobo Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience. (泰国专家Hu Hu Hu Huichong再次带领Tom Yum家族成员在曼谷介绍最新的旅游信息,包括光景绝佳的按摩院、新开的天空公园购物中心、以曼谷旅游为顶峰的自助餐厅。 内容在泰国确实非常丰富。 此外,博博黄金格尔(Bobo Huang Jingling)继续出现在这一集中,给予大量福利。 她将陪同Hu Hu Huichong访问Ayutthaya、Khao Yai和曼谷的其他地区,推荐当地民众的节日旅游目的地。 除了无包装的旅馆外,他们还将参观假日相点和酒店连锁儿童游乐场,保证泰国真正的体验。)

programme.title: Mystery Files ((苏联神秘档案))
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins. (爱是一个极其复杂的话题,周围环境因素众多,可以改变我们的梦想和对浪漫的理解。 从年龄变化、互联网文化的兴起、骗局和其他看似不寻常的原因等诸多因素导致社会上出现奇特的、充满世界观的爱情故事。 由Fire Lee、Jinny Ng和Randal Tsang主办的TVB+实况节目神秘文件邀请各行各业的人、名人客人和关系专家讨论每个事件的主题。 他们以独特的视角和发人深省的问题,大胆地探索情感困境,同时也欢迎观众通过现场聊天室和来宾参与对话并共同解决问题。)

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again ((中文))
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts, (你并非孤军奋战的归来者!在第二个赛季,节目再次由鬼王梁西浩王(Ghosts Leung Si Ho)和黄耀英、黄志燕(Wong Yiu Ying Ying)和编辑王志燕(Wong Ying Yeuk)和黄智燕(Tong Chi Yan)共同主持,让观众们更加高兴和惊讶。每集都关注不同的超自然主题,由分享幽灵故事并揭露宗教仪式和行业习俗秘密的重量级客人组成。在充满神秘的世界里,节目汇集了来自全球的超自然新闻,而志燕将前往南韩和台湾探索当地超自然现象。与观众的实时互动也是“精神联系”的亮点,与团队密切跟踪实况广播,)

And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small (香港:永远不要太小)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: News At 18:30 ((重轻参与的播客))
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30. (每天下午6点30分,Jade Channel报道了重要的当地,跨海峡和国际新闻.)

programme.title: Sunday Report 2026 Yes, Boss. ((册杀 Yes, Boss.))
programme.desc: Sunday Report focuses each week on popular newsmakers with feature reports, or takes a human-centered approach by visiting people from various social strata and industries to explore in depth political, social, and livelihood issues that concern the public. (星期天报告每周重点报道有专题报道的受欢迎的新闻制作者,或采取以人为中心的做法,访问来自各社会阶层和行业的人,深入探讨公众关注的政治、社会和生计问题。)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers. (Elena Kong再次领导团队,与张春龙、楚曼汉、吴宜宽和郑俊旺联合组建了Triing It Out团队,在第一季打完后以赞美和网友的热情赞美回来。 这次对台湾的新的深入探索将看到团队继续其放松、真实和自下而上的方式,引导观众深入岛屿心脏。 团队前往高盛、太南和台北,通过通过对极化的在线评论以及隐藏的宝石和鲜为人知的经验揭开有争议的商店,继续展示其精神。 团队致力于展示最真实的现场反馈,旨在创建实用的台湾旅游指南,避免观众陷入陷阱。)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2 ((女神配对计划 Sr.2))
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates. (与女神交配的真人秀《与女神的约会》又回到了一起,第二季的爱情战场也都升级了!金媒人鲍勃·拉姆正在从世界各地招募男人来配对女神何培霞、郭培勉、陈若熙、于克采诚和元甲曼。勇敢的追求者面临着挑战,比如,用他们自己的独特策略来赢得女神。一对一的亲密游戏点燃了燃心的兴奋情绪,一个隐藏的女神加入了这场争斗,进一步加大了等待的火花,勇敢的求婚者们努力到达终点并捕捉女神的心!此外,上个季节的五个女神,以及名人宾,将轮流成为Peanut小组,提供女神约会的现场报道。)

programme.title: Super Fun in Macau
programme.desc: Matthew Ho, along with members of the girl group MYNTSabrina Mendes,Carmen Ngai ,Ellyn Ngai ,Hilary Chong,Chelsea Mason and Skylar Lodeeply explored the streets and alleys of Macau, embarking on a fun-filled journey that combines innovative cuisine, century-old shops, unique crafts, and entertaining activities. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macaus unique leisure bus routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched Macau History Exploration Guide, allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.

programme.title: Star Weekly ((一周星星))
programme.desc: The talk show Star Weekly invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth! (脱口秀节目《星周刊》邀请名人和产业领袖及娱乐主持人, 如Au Wing- Quen、Hsu Wen-Husu、王朝川等, 分享他们最近的工作计划, 讨论有关电影、电视、音乐会等特别议题, 特别是网民及产业朋友关心及讨论的人士及活动! 节目内容多,)

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information. (香港是全球烹饪的熔炉。 食物锚和东道主如黄卡梅尼、 黄卡门、 吴嘉明、 吴吉良等,不断了解最新的烹饪趋势,收集各平台上顶级餐厅的信息,主播亲自抽样食物,提供诚实的检讨,发现不同区藏有的宝石,邀请长期外雇人员访问他们最喜爱的家乡菜园知名厨师和食品批评者,也引导他们走上道路,提供专家建议。 节目特别选取了《食品新闻报告》中热门的餐厅,突出他们的签名盘子,提供快速交易,确保观众了解最美味、最廉价的餐饮信息。)

programme.title: News Roundup ((现在不是出轨的问题))
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports. (报道来自香港,台湾海峡及世界各地的重大新闻,以及体育新闻,)

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.
