programme.desc: It is more than just a food and travel show as it is a cultural journey. The program blends travel, cuisine, and culture, inviting viewers not only to taste but also to experience the stories, people, and places behind Taiwanese food and destinations.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: A fresh travelogue that explores Taiwan through distinctive viewpoints and practical local knowledge. The hosts visit communities, attractions and food destinations, introducing the people and stories behind each stop.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: Led by experienced journalists, this current-affairs documentary travels beyond borders to investigate major international stories and social issues. Each report combines on-location observation, interviews and human perspectives to explain how global events affect ordinary lives.

programme.title: Mr.Player
programme.desc: Jacky Wu leads a team of celebrity guests through energetic missions staged in different destinations. The players compete in creative games, physical challenges and surprise tasks that test teamwork, strategy and humour.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Turns We Take ((杨龙澄))
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident (东北中国的一个味的热餐厅每天都为不同类型的客户服务.其中包括一个甜蜜的年轻夫妇,两个偏执不良的年轻人和一个出租车司机.)

programme.title: Ride On ((怪物猎人物语 RIDE ON))
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile. (卢老爷是一个被洗劫的特技演员,他训练他心爱的红兔马成为特技马。 但是,由于他的债务,红兔可能被债务国夺走。 卢老爷别无选择,只能从他离家出走的女儿那里寻求帮助,这一事件最终成为他们和解的良机。)

programme.title: The Sorcerer The White Snake ((白蛇传说))
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snakes true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony ((“骗骗”喜欢你2))
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate. (林清兰与骗子乌阳·胡伊合作,要求她收回被盗的钱.当他们建立了一个精心策划的骗子,夫妇在谎言,欺骗和命运扭曲中慢慢地对彼此产生意想不到的感觉.)

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures ((那些年，我们一起疯狂的事))
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends - Jia Yi, Kopi, Uncle, Wawa and Ah Di - decide to do something unforgettable together. Chasing dreams, friendship and youthful passion, they take on a seemingly impossible challenge, winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives and shape their future forever. (毕业前,五个高中朋友Jia Yi、Kopi、Uncle、Wawa和Ah Di决定一起做一件令人难忘的事情。 他们追求梦想、友谊和青春的激情,面对着似乎不可能的挑战,赢得了一场关键的篮球比赛,这可以改变他们的生活,塑造他们永远的未来。)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation. (警方专员离开香港后,便发生劫持警车事件。 李副局长领导了一个代号为冷战的救援行动。 肖恩副局长副局长西恩(Sean)试图控制李(Lee),因为他认为李(Lee)因儿子被扣为人质在情感上受到影响,但他的所作所为最终威胁到他们的声誉。)

programme.title: Burning Stars ((孤星计划))
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Better Days (更好的日子)
programme.desc: In this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature Film, Nian faces relentless bullying from her peers as she prepares for her college entrance exam. Fate leads her to streetwise punk Bei, but before they can retreat into their own world, both are embroiled in a murder investigation that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman (无敌剑术士)
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown. (为了摆脱武术世界,Linghu Chong陷入了敌对派别之间的激烈冲突。 他投身于神秘的Dongfang Bubai,他的秘密善行拯救了他。 但是,任Wo Xing操纵她相信她屠杀了其他门徒,而Linghu Chong却陷入了一场悲剧性的生死战。)

programme.title: Confinement ((分娩监禁))
programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby (怀孕的画家Si Ling,怀孕的画家,在获奖后搬进梦中家庭,并雇用了一名分娩保姆。 当她开始分娩后一个月的分娩时,家里开始发生难以解释的事件,威胁她和她的婴儿。)

programme.title: Tales From The Occult: Body And Soul ((失衡凶间之罪与杀))
programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns to feature three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist and a chef. The stories depict their paths from obsession to madness, eventually tipping them over to the dark side of human nature.

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Always Have Always Will ((原来时光都记得))
programme.desc: A struggling young man unexpectedly meets an optimistic, spirited young girl, and together they set off on an uncertain, soul-healing journey. Through lifes highs and lows, they stand by each other in hardship, their companionship mending the wounds they carry and reigniting hope in lifes darkest moments.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast ((金玉满堂))
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die ((提防老千))
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddys lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night ((风林火山))
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the familys empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his fathers followers fighting for control.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife ((犀利人妻))
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love? (因离婚后,她必须做一个关键决定.)

programme.title: Dust To Dust ((塵歸塵))
programme.desc: Back in 1995, the Police successfully arrested five armed bank robbers while the two masterminds got tipped off and made a clean escape. Decades later, retired cop Wang Shou Yue is drawn back to the unsolved case when he sees a blurred figure in a news clip. A battle between good and evil has just begun! (早在1995年,警方成功逮捕了五名持械银行劫匪,而两名幕后黑手则告密并逃脱。 几十年后,退休的警察王绍月在新闻短片中看到一个模糊的数字时,又回到了未破的案子。 善与恶的战斗才刚刚开始!)

programme.title: Welcome to My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways. (陈小周在痛苦的分手和奇特的事故后,被一群只有他能看见的摇摇晃晃晃的橡皮鸭缠住了。 每当他和欢乐的冯佳南在一起时,他的怪咒就会消失。 随着他们的亲近,一个荒谬而又令人心动的浪漫花花,以出乎意料的方式改变了他们的生活。)

programme.title: American Girl ((中文))
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Shadows Edge, The ((影子 Edge, The))
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation. (一群有技能的盗贼在利用天眼监控系统时抢走了一大笔十亿元的劫机,震撼了整个城市。 为了在罪犯再次袭击之前阻止罪犯,澳门警察招募退休的监视专家王德钟重建精英追踪队,并追捕幕后幕后幕后幕后幕后幕后幕人。)

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo ((山忌：黄衣小飞侠))
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Love Eterne ((七世夫妻之梁山伯与祝英台))
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave. (泰伪装为男孩去上学,爱上了同学博.发现她真实身份后,博提出婚约,才知道泰已与另一个男人交婚.被迫分离,博绝望地去世.被消息摧毁,博在他的坟墓上自杀.)

programme.title: Empress Wu ((唐朝禁宫秘史))
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor. (泽天是唐皇帝14岁的美丽和才华横溢的女神.她在唐皇帝去世后成为修道女,但与新皇帝唐高宗生了两个儿子.皇帝女士要求与她合作,反对夫人,但被设置并推翻了王位,他也杀了她的两个儿子.)

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets ((双镯))
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Dirty Ho ((臭臭和脏脏))
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot... (王师父,实际上是第十一位王子,扮演着古董的知识分子,以隐藏他的真实身份.)

programme.title: Hong Kong 73 ((香港'73))
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home... (在1973年,香港恒盛指数达到非凡的峰值,)

programme.title: The Battle Wizard ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobras blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his fathers old rival. (达利王子尤对武术没有任何了解,但离开宫殿前往武术世界.他遇到了一个蛇巫婆和他的神秘的半妹妹.通过各种不幸,尤通过吸着子的血和吞下魔术获得了无敌的力量,最终击败了他的父亲的老对手.)

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples ((弟子也疯狂))
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics. (故事围绕着沙olin寺的三个世俗门徒:Fang Shi Yu,Hong Xi Guan和Hu Hui Qian.杰教导他们武术,但他们与同学Wu Qing的频繁竞争激发了竞争.曾经平静的沙olin寺陷入混乱,但即使是修道士也无法避免被他们的恶作剧娱乐.)

programme.title: Killer Darts ((追魂镖))
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Lius disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu. (一群强盗袭击了箭师住在村庄,并杀害了他的妻子.在追捕他们时,李斯门徒杀死了一名农民和他的妻子,当她拒绝他的提前,导致收养了他们的孤儿女儿,并和儿子抚养她.多年后,女儿遇到了一个强盗的人,被骗去反对.)

programme.title: Dead End ((归去))
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead. (因在车辆崩后遇到了一个富有女孩文.因爱上了文,但文的兄弟不喜欢他,禁止他的妹妹见到他.他羞辱并打,所以拿着他在街上意外发现的枪到文的家,并射杀了她的兄弟.)

programme.title: The Black Lizard ((黑蜥蜴))
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fianc. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆皇奇遇记))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him? (龙皇帝不知名地与他的人民混在一起,了解他们的需要. 在路上,他遇到了许多奇怪的事情,包括被捕和几乎被砍了头.)

programme.title: Killer Constable ((万人斩))
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, hed still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tais best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion. Award winning actor Ku Feng is his equal, playing an especially homicidal robber-chief who thinks nothing of throwing all his men at their relentless pursuer. Lu Tsun and Huang Pei-chi choreograph the many battles featuring such action stalwarts as Pai Piao and Ai Fei.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow ((倩女幽魂))
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches. (一位年轻学者宁在一个可怕的寺里度过了晚上.据说是鬼鬼的.他不相信谣言,但很快遇到了一个美丽的女鬼尼.尼被迫留在寺里,以诱惑年轻人,让一个强大的恶魔吃饭.知道尼是一个善良的鬼,宁决定帮助她摆脱恶魔的抓住.)

programme.title: Bloody Parrot ((血鹦鹉))
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Happy Trio ((双星伴月))
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness... (小,一个被困在城市的村子女孩,与一个善良的流浪汉和一个退休演员结交朋友.他们穷但幸福,尽管小的财富变得更好,当她成为一名歌手.)

programme.title: The Water Margin ((水浒传))
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Masked Avengers ((叉手))
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial worlds greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gangs hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants ((欢笑老弄堂))
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman ((银剑杀手沈胜衣))
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan. (一个雄心勃勃的邪恶族群打算统治武术世界.为了实现他们的目标,他们必须首先偷走一个秘密武术手稿,描述如何制造枪支.然而,一个极其聪明的剑手沈伊正在保护这本手稿,并保持在邪恶族群的前进.)

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court ((锦衣卫))
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the governments secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperors ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles ((故都春梦))
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves. (范家舒是一位心地善良的学生,他与心地善良的爱歌歌手沈相爱,但并非只有他有对沈的目光,将军们的亲信也决心将歌唱者作为礼物送给上司。 范恩及时得到一个出乎意料的人的帮助,以拯救他所爱的女人。)

programme.title: Apartment For Ladies ((女子公寓))
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman ((怪侠))
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family. (壮丽的剑士以英雄为中心,他誓言要报复他小时候杀害他的家人的邪恶强盗.他招募了几名朋友来帮助农民摆脱掠夺性强盗的村庄,该团队的领导人是杀害他的家人的人.)

programme.title: Tales of Larceny ((牛鬼蛇神))
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step. (连接了所有老板,僧侣,乞和盗窃者的事,)

programme.title: The Duel ((怪兽雄师))
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father. (在知道他的兄弟杀死了一个竞争对手三级的头之后,承担了责任,被杀手追捕.)

programme.title: Jawaan
programme.desc: The film explores themes of vengeance and justice, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats.

programme.title: Karnan
programme.desc: Karnan, a fearless village youth, must fight for the rights of the conservative people of his village, due to the torture given by a police officer.

programme.title: Asvins
programme.desc: A bunch of YouTubers accidentally unleash a 1500-year-old evil from the dark realm, causing chaos in the human world. Now, they must band together to stop it!

programme.title: Thiruttu Payale 2
programme.desc: An honest police officer, under orders from a senior official, records conversations of elite professionals. While on duty, he discovers an online sociopath and decides to reveal his identity.

programme.title: Mapla Singam
programme.desc: Amidst the rivalry of two castes in a village, a leaders daughter falls in love with a boy from the rival caste. Things take a turn when her cousin Anbu falls in love with the boys sister.

programme.title: Bhaskar Oru Rascal
programme.desc: Two kids, each from a single-parent home, team up to bring their moms and dads together, hoping to create the happy, complete family theyve always wanted.

programme.title: Thondan
programme.desc: Narayanan, a politicians son, assaults Vishnu when his brother dies in his ambulance. Later, he makes Vishnus life miserable by bribing the local police officers and government officials.

programme.title: Tuck Jagadish
programme.desc: Bhudevipuram has a long history of families warring over ancestral property. However, when its headmans family falls into the same trap, his younger son decides to break the villages age-old legacy.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: When a famous cello player is found dead in a supposedly haunted house, his well-wishers and authorities investigate to determine if the death is caused by a supernatural entity.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Kurup
programme.desc: Driven by greed, Kurup weaves lies, fake deaths, and identity theft. His scheme takes a twist when a clever policeman starts pursuing him.

programme.title: Thangaraja
programme.desc: Engal Thanga Raja is about a brother who seeks revenge for the murder of his brother by pretending to be an escaped convict.

programme.title: Kanni Raasi
programme.desc: A joint family that supports only love marriages struggles to persuade their youngest member to fall in love, facing stubbornness, doubts, and heartfelt family dynamics.

programme.title: Raja Manthiri
programme.desc: Raja Manthiri is a drama genre film written and directed by Usha Krishnan and produced byP. G. Muthiah. The film stars Kalaiyarasan,Kaali Venkat,Shaalin Zoyaand Vaishali in the leading roles.

programme.title: Kennedy Club
programme.desc: Savarimuthu, an ex-soldier, falls sick while training the womens kabaddi team of his village. Soon, a former student named Muruganandham is chosen to take his place.

programme.title: Pathu Thala
programme.desc: An undercover police officer embarks on a mission to capture a crime boss and rescue a politician. However, what he discovers forces him to rethink his views on good and evil.

programme.title: Asuraguru
programme.desc: The life of a high-tech robber with exceptional skills of evading the law changes when a private detective tries to get a hold of him.

programme.title: Valimai
programme.desc: A citys crime rate rises due to a notorious motorcycle club. When chaos ensues, police officer Arjun takes charge to restore law and order.

programme.title: Extreme Treks (极端的行程)
programme.desc: Join Ryan and his team as they explore the city of Zurich, and then set out from Vaduz in Liechtenstein to embark on this mammoth trek towards Montreux on the shores of Lake Geneva, in this double episode of Extreme Treks.

programme.title: How The Wild Things Sleep
programme.desc: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv. (在繁殖季节,与米克和阿德尔交往,他们拯救了杰克·拉塞尔从一个皮的鱼.)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python. (准备好救援,当丹和杰斯从后院里取出东方棕色的,然后当米克在沙发枕头里嗅出一种高度有毒的蛇时, 保持呼吸.)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan. (看到米克和阿德尔抓住一个子监视器鱼追着子晚餐,然后抓住一个滑滑车库入侵者和杰斯和丹.)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies. (让斯图和利夫乱,他们试图取一个大蓝舌. 让杰斯和丹一起跑时间,他们试图拯救一个怀孕的蛇,)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas ((阿尔法战士))
programme.desc: Avoid the swords, spikes, and deadly hood ornaments on these alpha hunters. Observe elands locking corkscrew horns, storks rattling sabre-shaped beaks, rhinos scaring the competition with massive horns, and striped marlins spearing unsuspecting prey.

programme.title: Ocean Parks (海洋公园)
programme.desc: Deep in the South Caribbean Sea, explore the protected waters of Bonaire National Marine Park, home to thriving reefs, endangered sea turtles, sprawling mangroves, and a plethora of marine life. (在南加勒比海深处,探索博纳尔国家海洋公园的受保护水域,)

programme.title: Baboons: Rules Of The Troop ((狒狒：部落的法则))
programme.desc: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

programme.title: Into The Wild India ((深入印度))
programme.desc: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

programme.title: Into The Wild India ((深入印度))
programme.desc: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of Indias most iconic creatures to thrive the Greater One-horned Rhino.

programme.title: Into The Wild India ((深入印度))
programme.desc: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown!

programme.title: Into The Wild India ((深入印度))
programme.desc: In a land of heat and tropical storms, life on the plains of southern India is tough. But Bibi, a female sloth bear with two cubs, is up for the challenge of her life as she fights against drought, food scarcity, and predators around every corner.

programme.title: Into The Wild India ((深入印度))
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: Animal Empires (动物帝国)
programme.desc: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies - and raising them - is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability of youth and the threats of the wild.

programme.title: Animal Empires (动物帝国)
programme.desc: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires - like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

programme.title: Animal Empires (动物帝国)
programme.desc: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

programme.title: Animal Empires (动物帝国)
programme.desc: Uninvited guests. Using sheer numbers to claim a territory, some animal groups are considered pests. But their very survival may depend on finding a home where theyre not welcome. (动物群体被认为是害虫,但它们的生存可能取决于找到一个不欢迎的家.)

programme.title: Animal Empires (动物帝国)
programme.desc: Theres strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, its the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation - finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks. (了解这些生物的优势 帮助这些史前物种生存下来 经历了多次大规模灭绝 并被公牛鲨鱼无情的捕猎技巧所迷惑)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to todays modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in. (重新审视褐熊的进化历程,从主宰冰河时代的乌希德祖先到现代食肉动物。 见证它们与鲑鱼的共生关系以及它们生长的令人惊讶的相互关联的生态系统。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivores extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africas most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial males bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Animals Decoded ((动物解码))
programme.desc: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate. (研究动物的交流方式。 找出狼群如何使用身体语言将狼群团结起来 并维持一个复杂的社会结构, 并看到惊人的手势黑猩猩用来交流。)

programme.title: Animals Decoded ((动物解码))
programme.desc: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef. (探索自然界,探索超乎人类耳朵的频率,比如晚上鹿的轻轻声,)

programme.title: Animals Decoded ((动物解码))
programme.desc: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand. (尚未发现的动物语言能拯救我们最濒危物种中的某些物种吗?从微妙的气味到人类眼中看不见的颜色,揭示隐藏的动物交流方式,科学家们才刚刚开始了解这些方式。)

programme.desc: The Eastern Grey kangaroo is a sociable species, clustering together in small groups known as mobs. A mob is a social network focused on feeding, where members will come and go as they please, depending on the availability of food.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo ((袋鼠的秘密生活))
programme.desc: Eastern Grey kangaroos are prolific breeders, but bringing up baby is fraught with challenges. Predators, climate extremes, and lively joeys mean kangaroo mothers face a daily struggle to keep their young alive.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Kangaroo ((袋鼠的秘密生活))
programme.desc: Follow several different males as they roam the land, climb up the social ladder, and fight for their mating rights in Eastern Grey colony. For these bucks, the drive to perpetuate their species promises a life full of risk and reward.

programme.title: Wild Crusades ((十字军（中世纪天主教会的军队）))

programme.title: Wild Crusades ((十字军（中世纪天主教会的军队）))
programme.desc: Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Endemic to the island, these feisty group-living monkeys are found nowhere else on earth. And they are at the heart of the longest primate research project ever undertaken. Dr Wolfgang Dittus is on a quest to understand their complex society.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 嘥料
programme.desc: 這一集， ３位主持要赴極之期待的約會，就是城中著名的米芝蓮飯店去品嚐收藏左15年的18頭日本吉品鮑，溏心！軟糯！配以白飯青菜，去享用濃厚的鮑汁每一口都係是年月精華!這麼矜貴的乾鮑給3位主持去烹調，必定嘥料，所以製作組今次準備了2件比手掌更大的湯鮑給他地們試練WinWin 跟 George 弄了一份玉子燒鮑魚三文治，非常豪氣辣妹嘉倩就用日本咖哩去煮鮑魚，結果強烈的咖哩蓋過了鮑魚的鮮味，完全嘥料！

programme.title: One Day 約會實況
programme.desc: 第四位女嘉賓是可愛活潑的女神，相信是最多男生喜愛的類型，但又是否Marco能應付的類型呢？神隊友Sica及Alice 看似很了解女神，卻又給了山埃錦囊，不單止要約女神食飯這麼簡單，還要出海！一來就挑戰如此高難度的級數！究竟Marco可否順利在女神眼中留下好印象呢？

programme.title: 打開你雪櫃
programme.desc: Eden 及健相戀多年，終共築愛巢，縱使親友未完全知道二人關係，仍無阻二人勇敢去愛，更常常飛去世界各地旅行，享受二人世界，二人曾嘗試在幾千海拔的高山上爭執，可謂愛得轟烈！小谷親臨二人家，送上西班牙海鮮飯及奇亞籽甜品，一同探討何謂愛的真締

programme.title: 舉頭三尺
programme.desc: Kathy仔與YOYO來到苗栗百年火車隧道像時空隧道穿越了古今，任務是拍媽祖搭火車！？順利完成任務後才知道原來此媽祖並非任務中要找尋的媽祖，費盡千辛萬苦後終於見到媽祖，為何祂的臉那麼熟悉呢？苗栗后厝龍鳳宮，俗稱后厝媽祖廟，建於清道光16年，至今有200 多年的歷史，龍鳳宮在後殿建造有45米高約12層樓的天上聖母寶像，耗費三年建成，神像線條柔美順暢，以當時工藝實屬難得完工後，龍鳳宮即被信眾俗稱大媽祖

programme.title: 區區都有STEM
programme.desc: 今集，主持Gracey和STEM Sir 前往沙田香港無舉辦任何賽車比賽，但四驅車比賽就經常性出現，到底四驅車比賽是比什麼，講求什麼技術？城門河一帶有不少人練習划艇，到底水面張力，會怎樣影響划艇的速度？馬場是指賽馬的地方馬路是指以前讓馬行駛的路，那走馬燈又是什麼？為什麼視覺暫留可以造就看到動畫的錯覺？

programme.title: 我要爆Show
programme.desc: 爆Show之路來到中段，Dixon剖白自己一直逃避面對的問題製作組特別邀請彭秀慧指導Dixon，透過劇場訓練，一步一步剖開Dixon對於演藝事業失去熱情的根源真情流露過後的Dixon亦即將重新振作，重拾對於演出的樂趣，在最終考驗中展現自己最真誠的表演

programme.title: 我們與金牌的距離
programme.desc: 每集主持都要對戰專業的香港運動員，務求拼盡全力爭取一分！作為香港劍擊代表隊的大師兄，小倫有甚麼風浪沒見過？但今集竟然被 Phoebus 和 Fi 的劍擊知識嚇到，難道兩位主持真的可以亂拳打死老師傅？！兩位徒弟跟隨師傅訓練，過程中不斷密謀如何戰勝小倫，還竟然意外發現小倫的弱點？！

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 近日護士畢業生就業問題引起社會關注，醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂接受大鳴大放專訪時只要畢業生肯入醫管局，99％受聘，他並以醫管局招聘數據粉碎坊間謬誤，強調畢業等同失業的說法是錯誤他對近日所謂護士畢業生的失業個案，逐一反駁盧寵茂指其中一個個案稱非本地培訓護士搶了他的精神科護士職位，盧寵茂直指公營醫療體系沒有聘請過一名非本地培訓的精神科護士：不知道為甚麼，他是不是有一個錯覺，看到香港公立醫院內有非本地培訓精神科護士，這是一個錯覺盧寵茂引了一個個案，稱一名護士畢業生去應聘醫管局，醫管局聘請他，他卻不做而去旅遊，一年後回來卻投訴醫管局不再聘請他盧寵茂指年輕人有自己的職業規劃，有能力選擇畢業不用工作：做一名僱主，大部分的僱主，如果你說有個人原本來做的，然後說我聘請你你又不做，你自己去玩完之後又回來說我想做，對僱主來說這是一個顧慮盧寵茂指在專業考慮上，一名護士一整年沒有做護士工作，他又以自己身為一名外科醫生為例，一年沒有從業，做手術的技術亦會生疏，作為僱主會考慮申聘者的專業問題盧寵茂強調畢業就失業的說法是錯，他重申護士畢業是有工做，不過有人選擇不去做他再舉例，其中一個個案要選擇在家隔壁醫院才去應聘： 個案說我很想在我家隔壁的醫院做，但又沒有職位給我，這個案又不是説沒有工做，是有工做，不過你選擇在家隔壁的醫院但這些例子出來形成一種聲音盧寵茂指出醫護人手每三年做一次估算，他再引用醫管局招聘護士的中央數據指出，202425年潛在有超過4000名護士畢業生，只有3500名註冊做護士；當中的差距可能有些學護未畢業，或有些選擇不從事護士行業所以不去做註冊他重申醫管局的招聘名額相當多，但4000名潛在畢業生只有2500多名來應聘，換言之有4成沒有來醫管局找工作，所以不是醫管局不聘請他們，而是他們自己的職業發展未必想在公立醫院做前線

programme.title: 我想身體健康

programme.title: CHILL CLUB

programme.title: 在絕版前放浪一次

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: 너의 이름은.
programme.desc: 도쿄 소년 타키와 시골 소녀 미츠하는 자꾸 몸이 뒤바뀐다. 이런 일이 반복되자 서로 규칙을 만들어 행동하던 어느 날, 미츠하가 타키의 휴대폰에 남겨놓았던 흔적들이 모두 사라져버린다. 이를 이상하게 여긴 타키는 기억을 되짚어서 그녀가 살던 마을로 향하지만, 그 마을은 3년 전 혜성 충돌로 인해 이미 사라져버린지 오래. 타키는 참사 당일의 미츠하와 다시 몸을 바꿔서 마을을 구조하는 계획을 세우게 되는데...

programme.title: 보이스
programme.desc: 소리를 단서로 사건을 해결하는 소리추격 스릴러 우리가 목숨걸고 지킨 3분은 누군가의 인생이다! 상담원이라는 별명으로 불리며 가장 변방으로 취급 받지만, 사실 삶과 죽음을 가르는 가장 긴박한 순간들이 모인 112 신고센터 3분 도착, 5분 현장 확인, 10분 검거의 긴박한 타임 리밋 속에서 범죄현장의 골든타임을 사수하는 112 신고센터 대원들의 치열한 기록을 생생하게 담아내고, 우리 인생의 골든타임, 결코 포기해서는 안되는 그 순간의 용기에 대해 이야기한다.

programme.title: 대한민국을 바꾼 법의 탄생 : 헌법을 말하다
광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 로보카 폴리 시즌1
programme.desc: 아름다운 섬마을 브룸스타운에는 날마다 크고 작은 사고가 끊이지 않는데... 사건이 일어날 때마다 로봇으로 변신하는 용감한 구조대, 로보카 폴리 출동!

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 동시방영작눈을 떴더니 최강 무장과 우주선을 가지고 있어서, 집 한 채를 목표로 용병으로 자유롭게 ...

programme.title: 파파독
programme.desc: 늘 사랑스럽고 씩씩한 골목대장 별이. 하지만 그런 별이도 가끔은 쓸쓸한 모습을 보일 때가 있다. 그 이유는 별이의 가장 친한 친구이자 든든한 보호자가 되어 주었던 아빠가 해외 출장을 갔기 때문인데... 오늘도 홀로 가방을 챙기고 학교로 향하는 별이, 그런데 왠 개 한마리가 앞을 가로 막는다. 별이를 보며 반갑다는 듯 꼬리를 흔들던 개! 갑자기 두발로 일어나더니 사람처럼 말을 하기 시작하는데... 별아, 내가 니 아빠다, Im your farther! 어이없는 상황에 눈이 휘둥그래진 별이, 그리고 감정이 북받치는 듯 눈물을 흘리는 개! 과연 어떻게 된 일일까?? 배꼽 잡는 소동과 따뜻한 가족의 사랑이 담긴, 아빠가 개가 됐어요!, 개 변신 애니시트콤 파파독의 이야기가 시작된다.
